42018.commentary: (ANa) pathavīsamenā'ti akujjhan'aṭṭhena pathaviyā samānena. na hi pathavī, mayi suciṃ nikkhipantī'ti somanassaṃ karoti, na asuciṃ nikkhipantī'ti domanassaṃ. mayham'pi evarūpaṃ cittan'ti dasseti.

ko imaṃ pathaviṃ vicessati, yamalokañ'ca imaṃ sadevakaṃ, ko dhammapadaṃ sudesitaṃ, kusalo puppham'iva pacessati.

42041.meaning2: perceiving the earth; seeing the ground
42041.commentary: (DNa) ākāse pathavīsaññiniyo'ti ākāse pathaviṃ māpetvā tattha pathavīsaññiniyo. (DNa) sant'ānanda, devatā pathaviyaṃ pathavīsaññiniyo'ti pakatipathavī kira devatā dhāretuṃ na sakkoti. tattha hatthako brahmā viya devatā osīdanti. ten'āha bhagavā, oḷārikaṃ hatthaka, attabhāvaṃ abhinimmināhī'ti (a. ni. 3.128). tasmā yā devatā pathaviyaṃ pathaviṃ māpesuṃ, tā sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ, pathaviyaṃ pathavīsaññiniyo'ti.

examples.text: sant'ānanda, devatā ākāse pathavīsaññiniyo kese pakiriya kandanti, bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinnapātaṃ papatanti, āvaṭṭanti, vivaṭṭanti, atikhippaṃ bhagavā parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ sugato parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ cakkhuṃ loke antaradhāyissatī'ti

yo kāme parivajjeti, sappass'eva padā siro, so imaṃ visattikaṃ, loke sato samativattati.
añña'd'atthu, ayaṃ varāko idāni marissati, yaṃ yadeva hi ayaṃ padaṃ nikkhipati, tena tena santike maraṇassa hotī'ti taṃ jano karuṇāyati.
yass'āsavā parikkhīṇā, āhāre ca anissito, suññato animitto ca, vimokkho yassa gocaro, ākāse va sakuntānaṃ, padaṃ tassa durannayaṃ.
appamādo amatapadaṃ, pamādo maccuno padaṃ, appamattā na mīyanti, ye pamattā yathā matā.
sahassam'api ce gāthā, anatthapadasaṃhitā, ekaṃ gāthāpadaṃ seyyo, yaṃ sutvā upasammati.
padaso nāma padaṃ, anupadaṃ, anvakkharaṃ, anubyañjanaṃ.
maggān'aṭṭh'aṅgiko seṭṭho, saccānaṃ caturo padā, virāgo seṭṭho dhammānaṃ, dvipadānañ'ca cakkhumā.
tesaṃ no, bhante, āyasmatā mahākaccānena imehi ākārehi imehi padehi imehi byañjanehi attho vibhatto'ti
jaheyya sabbasaṃyogaṃ, kareyya saraṇ'attano, careyy'ādittasīso'va, patthayaṃ accutaṃ padan'ti.
avijjāya tv'eva tamokāyassa asesavirāganirodho, santam'etaṃ padaṃ paṇītam'etaṃ padaṃ, yadidaṃ, sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.

isisattamassa akuhassa, tevijjassa brahmapattassa, nhātakassa padakassa, passaddhassa viditavedassa, purin'dadassa sakkassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.

42064.meaning1: who understands correctly; who grasps in the right way

42065.grammar: idiom, fem + abs, abs of padakkhiṇaṃ karoti
42065.meaning1: having gone around a person to the right out of respect; having circled around to the right

examples.text: vandanaṃ dāni vajjāsi, lokanāthaṃ anuttaraṃ, padakkhiṇañ'ca katvāna, ādiseyyāsi dakkhiṇaṃ.
atha kho nakulapitā gahapati bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yen'āyasmā sāriputto ten'upasaṅkami

42066.meaning2: to go round, keeping the right side turned towards a respectful person or an object of veneration, circumambulation

examples.text: atha kho ambapālī gaṇikā bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
atha kho nakulapitā gahapati bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yen'āyasmā sāriputto ten'upasaṅkami

42069.meaning1: (gram) word breakup; deconstruction of a word

examples.text: dīgharattassa [dīgharattaṃ + assā'ti padacchedo]

42070.meaning1: kind of footprint; type of spoor

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yāni kānici jaṅgalānaṃ pāṇānaṃ padajātāni, sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchanti, hatthipadaṃ tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati, yadidaṃ mahantattena
lakkhaṇ'ādīsu ca tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ sabhāvo vā sāmaññaṃ vā lakkhaṇaṃ nāma, kiccaṃ vā sampatti vā raso nāma, upaṭṭhān'ākāro vā phalaṃ vā paccupaṭṭhānaṃ nāma, āsannakāraṇaṃ padaṭṭhānaṃ nāma.

42073.meaning1: fact of being the proximate cause

examples.text: pakāsanā'ti paṭhamaṃ kāsanā, kāsīyati dīpīyatī'ti attho. iminā hi atthapadadvayena akkharapadehi vibhāviyamāno atthākāro gahito. yasmā akkharehi suyyamānehi suṇantānaṃ visesavidhānassa katattā padapariyosāne pad'atthasampaṭipatti hoti.

42077.meaning1: who merely knows the words (not the meaning)
42077.commentary: (ANa) katamo ca puggalo padaparamo, yassa puggalassa bahum'pi suṇato bahum'pi bhaṇato bahum'pi dhārayato bahum'pi vācayato na tāya jātiyā dhamm'ābhisamayo hoti, ayaṃ vuccati puggalo padaparamo'ti. (ANt) byañjanapadam'eva paramaṃ assā'ti padaparamo.

examples.text: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. katame cattāro? ugghaṭitaññū, vipañcitaññū, neyyo, padaparamo, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.

42078.meaning2: end of the sentence; end of the phrase

examples.text: iccā'ti padasandhi padasaṃsaggo padapāripūrī akkharasamavāyo byañjanasiliṭṭhatā padānupubbatāpetaṃ, iccā'ti.

42080.meaning1: (gram) filling up the metre; completing a verse
42080.commentary: (VINt) avadhāraṇaphalattā saddappayogassa sabbam'pi vākyaṃ antogadh'āvadhāraṇan'ti āha kho'ti padapūraṇamatte nipāto'ti.

42081.commentary: (MNa) parimaṇḍalehi padabyañjanehī'ti ettha padam'eva atthassa byañjanato padabyañjanaṃ, taṃ akkharapāripūriṃ katvā dasavidhabyañjanabuddhiyo aparihāpetvā vuttaṃ parimaṇḍalaṃ nāma hoti, evarūpehi padabyañjanehī'ti attho.

examples.text: tassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno bhāsitaṃ n'eva abhinanditabbaṃ nappaṭikkositabbaṃ. anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā tāni padabyañjanāni sādhukaṃ uggahetvā sutte otāretabbāni, vinaye sandassetabbāni.
so catassannaṃ parisānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti parimaṇḍalehi padabyañjanehi anuppabandhehi anusayasamugghātāya. evarūpena kho, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyā'ti.

42082.meaning2: dividing of word, treating each word separately

42083.meaning2: who recites the word of the Scriptures

examples.text: so'pi tesaṃ gatabhāvaṃ ñatvā vaccakuṭiyā padaraṃ vivaritvā oruyha ubhohi hatthehi ālopaṃ ālopaṃ katvā gūthaṃ khādi

42086.commentary: (SNa) padaraṃ nāma aṭṭhamāse deve avassante phalito bhūmippadeso.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, uparipabbate thullaphusitake deve vassante taṃ udakaṃ yathāninnaṃ pavattamānaṃ pabbatakandarapadarasākhā paripūreti
taṃ nadīhi vijānātha, sobbhesu padaresu ca, saṇantā yanti kusobbhā, tuṇhīyanti mah'odadhī.

42087.commentary: (VINa) padarasañcitaṃ hotī'ti yassā uparimatalaṃ dāruphalakehi vā ghanasanthataṃ hoti, sudhādiparikammakataṃ vā tatthā'pi anāpatti. (KVt) uparitalaṃ vā padarasañcitan'ti uparimatalaṃ dāruphalakehi ghanasanthataṃ.

examples.text: anāpatti, avehāsakuṭiyā sīsaghaṭṭāya heṭṭhā aparibhogaṃ hoti, padarasañcitaṃ hoti, paṭāṇi dinnā hoti, tasmiṃ ṭhito gaṇhati vā laggeti vā, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

42088.meaning1: broken in conduct; defective in behaviour
42088.commentary: (MNa) padasamācāro'ti dubbalasamācāro oḷārik'ācāro, paccayesu sāpekkho mahārakkhitatthero viya. taṃ kira upaṭṭhākakule nisinnaṃ upaṭṭhāko āha asukattherassa me, bhante, cīvaraṃ dinnan'ti. sādhu te kataṃ taṃ'y'eva takketvā viharantassa cīvaraṃ dentenā'ti. tumhākam'pi, bhante, dassāmī'ti. sādhu karissasi taṃ'y'eva takkentassā'ti āha. ayam'pi evarūpo oḷārik'ācāro ahosi.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe. tena kho pana samayena goliyāni nāma bhikkhu āraññiko padarasamācāro saṅghamajjhe osaṭo hoti kenaci'd'eva karaṇīyena.

42089.meaning2: form of a word; spelling of a word

42090.meaning1: name of grammatical treatise by Buddhappiya in the Kaccāyana tradition
42090.meaningLit: completion of the final form of the word

examples.text: disvāna vāmena hatthena habyasesaṃ gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena kamaṇḍaluṃ gahetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami. atha kho bhagavā sundarikabhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa padasaddena sīsaṃ vivari.

42093.meaning1: (gram) joining of words; combination of words

examples.text: iccā'ti padasandhi padasaṃsaggo padapāripūrī akkharasamavāyo byañjanasiliṭṭhatā padānupubbatāpetaṃ, iccā'ti.
ajja't'agge'ti ajjataṃ ādiṃ katvā, ajja'd'agge'ti vā pāṭho, dakāro padasandhikaro, ajja aggaṃ katvā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

42094.meaning1: (gram) helping the joining of words; supporting the combination of words

examples.text: ajjatan'ti ajjabhāvaṃ. ajja'd'agge'ti vā pāṭho, da-kāro padasandhikaro, ajja aggaṃ katvā'ti attho.

42096.commentary: (MNa) padasamācāro'ti dubbalasamācāro oḷārik'ācāro, paccayesu sāpekkho mahārakkhitatthero viya.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena goliyāni nāma bhikkhu āraññiko padasamācāro saṅghamajjhe osaṭo hoti kenaci'd'eva karaṇīyena.

42097.meaning1: (gram) combining of words; connecting of words

examples.text: iccā'ti padasandhi padasaṃsaggo padapāripūrī akkharasamavāyo byañjanasiliṭṭhatā padānupubbatāpetaṃ, iccā'ti.

42098.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of pada, irreg
42098.commentary: (VINa) padasā nessāmī'ti tajjento vā paharanto vā ito gacchāhī'ti vadati, tena vuttadisābhāgaṃ gacchantassa dutiyapadavārena pārājikaṃ.

examples.text: sahabhaṇḍahārakaṃ padasā nessāmī'ti paṭhamaṃ pādaṃ saṅkāmeti, āpatti thull'accayassa.
tasmiṃ pana nagare anusaṃvaccharaṃ vivaṭanakkhattaṃ nāma hoti. tadā bahi anikkhamanakulāni'pi parivārena saddhiṃ gehā nikkhamitvā appaṭicchannena sarīrena padasā'va nadītīraṃ gacchanti

42099.meaning2: (gram) derivation of word, completion of a word

examples.text: araññe rukkhamūle vā, suññ'āgāre'va bhikkhavo, anussaretha [anussareyyātha padasiddhi pana cintetabbā] sambuddhaṃ, bhayaṃ tumhāka no siyā.
api ca āgadanaṃ āgado, vacanan'ti attho. tayo aviparīto āgado assā'ti, da-kārassa ta-kāraṃ katvā tathāgato'ti evam'etasmiṃ atthe padasiddhi veditabbā.
